newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products propelled higher by Iraqi news.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products propelled higher by Iraqi news.

text.p: NWE oil products rocketed on Monday, spurred by surging oil futures, traders said. Naphtha prices were sharply higher with stronger gasoline creating demand for tight N+A material.
Eurograde gasoline barges jumped $11 a tonne with some good buying seen in early business as a number of buyers sought to cover short positions. Closed U.S. markets saw cargo trade thin.
Gas oil surged on soaring futures. Low German household stocks and renewed French heating oil demand lent support.
High and low sulphur cracked fuel oil was firmer. High sulphur barges traded as high as $105 fob ARA.
